purpose: Verify official Docker oracle harness can execute one published gold-patch example on a GitHub-hosted runner. This is NOT an agent trial, blind evaluation, X1 policy result, or benchmark performance estimate.
constraints: No model-driven coding agent is invoked
The reference patch is known and is used ONLY to diagnose the executable harness
No hidden oracle results are used for any prespecified X1 acceptance decision
Publish complete errors and do not impute failures or successes when the oracle does not run
Calibration task cannot be included as a held-out X1 experiment
Record exact upstream commit, dependency versions, Docker image digest, runnable test receipts, raw test output and GitHub run identity when available
primary_feasibility_endpoints: official evaluator returns report.json for the exact instance
test_output.txt includes START and END test markers
FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS are parsed from executed tests
Docker image provenance and log artifacts are retained
notes: Reruns should be labeled repeats of this calibration, never independent cases.
